items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: Mr. Shepherd, he came down and said, boys, you got any money? Buy Bethlehem Steel and put it away.

ctx.x: See, where I played, after I got out of high school, I played down on this place in North Redding. It was a roadhouse, see. And these stockbrokers would come down and say, you got any money? Buy so-and-so. Bethlehem Steel was selling at -- I think it was $40

a share or something like that. And, man, I'll never forget it. Mr. Shepherd, he came down and said, boys, you got any money? Buy Bethlehem Steel and put it away. You know what? Bethlehem Steel went up to $700 a share.
And I said, look, why didn't I buy some steel? But I used to get some stock that was about 75 cents a share. I used to buy ten or 20 shares, and it would go up and sell it out.
